test_cases.title: Applicant opens the terrestrial disease ranking report
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the terrestrial disease ranking report - features/report-windows/report-windows.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the disease ranking page
steps.expected: The disease ranking page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Select "Disease ranking report: Terrestrial diseases" in the disease ranking report list
steps.expected: A new browser window opens for the report

steps.action: Check for a new browser window
steps.expected: A new browser window opens for the ShowDiseaseRankingReport report

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant opens a published profile report from the profile reports page
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens a published profile report from the profile reports page - features/report-windows/report-windows.feature:66

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search disease profiles page
steps.expected: The Search disease profiles page is displayed with the search box and filters

steps.action: Enter "African Horse Sickness" in the Search for disease profiles field
steps.expected: "African Horse Sickness" is shown in the field

steps.action: Click the Search profiles button
steps.expected: The search results list is displayed

steps.action: Click the link to the profile reports (View reports) for the first result
steps.expected: The Profile reports page is displayed

steps.action: Click the title of the first report in the Profile reports list
steps.expected: The report opens in a new browser window

steps.action: Check for a new browser window
steps.expected: A new browser window opens for the ShowPublishedProfile report
